title: The porch light at the end of a date
old_caption: The porch light's whole shift: on at dusk, totally not counting the minutes, dimming to mood lighting, eyes shut through goodbye number three. Has a porch light ever seen you like this?

title: Pisces' tissue box: busy from 7 AM
old_caption: Pisces' tissue box clocked in at 7 AM for a sunrise, worked through a sweet text at lunch and pre-date nerves, then the date cried too. Thankfully they brought a refill. Tag your Pisces.

title: Expectation: candlelit homemade dinner
old_caption: The plan: candles, a rose, a perfect roast. The reality at midnight: a pasta brick, plan B cereal, and one clean spoon to share. Five stars. Who's cooking for you next?

title: Expectation: a smooth slow dance
old_caption: Expectation: a ballroom, a chandelier and a perfect dip. Reality: a living room, stepped-on toes and a dip that ended flat on the rug. They invented a dance anyway. Who's your two-left-feet partner?

title: Expectation: a sleek date outfit
old_caption: Expectation: red carpet, a gold bow tie, dark shades. Reality: Libra opens the door in a big mustard sweater, and Scorpio is wearing the exact same one. Socks too. Ever accidentally matched your date?

title: Expectation: a perfect picnic
old_caption: The plan: golden hour, sandwich tower, strawberries. The reality: ants, wind, and the ants taking the last sandwich. Still a ten out of ten. Worst date that became your favorite?

title: Expectation: shooting stars
old_caption: They planned a night of shooting stars and got clouds, more clouds, and one cloud that looked suspiciously like Sag. So they talked until sunrise instead. Best plan that ever fell apart?

title: First-date edition
old_caption: Twenty minutes early, practiced the laugh, three outfits, and said 'you too' to 'enjoy your meal.' Then the date turned out to be playing too. Both at zero. How many fingers would you have left?

title: Overthinker edition
old_caption: Virgo tried to cheat on a finger and the stars saw it. Re-read a text forty times, decoded a full stop, replayed a 'hi' from last week. How many fingers did you lose?

title: Planner edition
old_caption: A backup plan for the backup plan, the menu read in advance, the walk from parking timed twice, and color-coded index cards. And the best part was the wrong turn. Planners, how many fingers down?
